weapon.d: Neutralizes "effective against dragons" bonuses. Grants Spd+3. At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 50%, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 during combat. If foe's Range = 2, calculates damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res.

special.d: Boosts damage by 30% of unit's Spd. Restores HP = 30% of damage dealt.

a.d: Unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range.

b.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 90%, grants Special cooldown charge +1 to unit and inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on foe per attack. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 70%, grants Special cooldown charge +1 to unit and inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on foe per attack. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 50%, grants Special cooldown charge +1 to unit and inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on foe per attack. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)

c.d: At start of turn, inflicts Res-3 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Res-3 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Res-4 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, if unit is within 2 spaces of a foe, grants Atk/Res+5 to unit for 1 turn and inflicts Atk/Res-5 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.

builds.name: A Merry Demon or Sothis in Formation!
builds.desc:
First, you've got to accept the sad fact that Distant Counter isn't built into her weapon, then, work with what you've got; Player and Enemy Phase functionality in her weapon and reliable sustain on her special. So, combine the idea about Dual-Phase and maybe a peeve about even stats; Atk/Def Unity saves the day!
She functions surprisingly well with the base Armored unit movement. Regardless, the Orders effect makes her fly; it's almost excessive as the Save skill provides, 'sufficient' mobility, but Orders really does make Dual-Phase sublime.
Extra Skill Information and Alternatives:
+Atk is the usual preference as she has a +4 asset there as opposed to +3 in Spd. That said, she is not an armored unit that uses a guaranteed follow-up attack skill, and thusly relies on every bit of Spd that she can muster. And, since newer units boast higher stat averages the speed is my preference to stay functional.
Swap is nice for Armored units, but the Save skill tends to make Reposition the worthwhile choice as it enables your offensive/attacking Player Phase unit to gain the ground needed as opposed to just setting up a comfortable Enemy Phase.
Even Defense and Resistance Combo: (+5 Def from Unity) Ward Dragons S (on allied Dragon), Def/Res Bond, D/R Near Save and Partner Support Rank S.
Of Note:
With this setup unaugmented Sothis' base 30 Def idles between 43 and 51 (depending on phase and ally proximity).
The key is that every skill (besides Save) is functioning during Player Phase.
Certainly seek an alternative means of addressing ranged threats.
Consider actively trying to get de-buffed to fully utilize the Unity effect.
